summary: The official Dragonheir Discord is hosting the Halloween Revelry event until November 9. Players can participate in Trick or Treat by typing `!trickortreat` or tagging friends in the event channel to earn Candy. Rolling 95 or higher with `!ghost` or responding to ghost knocks with `!open` grants exclusive CDK codes. If the server reaches 50,000 total Candy, all participants receive 300 Wyrmarrow, 1 Mini Stamina Bread, and 5 Million Gold. Players must link their Discord account to their game account to receive rewards.
tips: Link your Discord account to your game account to receive Halloween Revelry event rewards.
Tag a friend using `!trickortreat @friend` in the Discord event channel so both of you receive Candy.
Type `!ghost` to roll a D100 for a chance to win an exclusive CDK code if you roll 95 or higher.
title: Halloween Revelry 🎃 Roll 95+ for a Code! Official Discord Event | Dragonheir #shorts
